**👋 Welcome to the Badge Help channel!**
We are here to help you gamify your profile. Please fill out the template below so the community can assist you.

### 🏅 Which badge are you trying to unlock?
*(e.g., Pull Shark, Pair Extraordinaire, Galaxy Brain)*

### 🛠️ What steps have you taken so far?
*(Please describe exactly what you did. E.g., "I opened a PR on the first-contributions repo and it was merged.")*

### ⏳ How long has it been since you completed the steps?
*(Remember: GitHub's backend jobs can take 24-48 hours to award some badges!)*

### 🔗 Link to your Pull Request / Issue / Discussion
*(Please provide the URL to the exact place where you performed the action, so we can verify if you did it correctly!)*
